reasons: CS2220 is only offered in Sem 1, so it must be taken in Sem 4. CS4330 is only offered in Sem 2, so it must be taken in Sem 7 or later.

CS3268 is only offered in Sem 1. Its prerequisite CS2109S must be completed in a strictly earlier semester. CS2109S is offered in Sem 1 and 2. Taking CS2109S in Sem 4 (Sem 2) allows CS3268 in Sem 5 (Sem 1).

CS3240 requires CS2111 (Sem 4) and is offered in Sem 1, so it fits in Sem 5. CS3223 and CS3230 have no Sem 1/2 restrictions blocking them from Sem 6, and their prerequisites are met by Sem 4/5 courses.
